notes: Documented influence pairs for ELTeC-fra, checked against the corpus holdings
(100 novels, 74 authors, 1840-1920). Author strings are substring-matched
against TEI <author> surnames. Sources precede targets at the novel level,
so the pipeline's temporal filter retains every pair.
'Le Roman', preface to Pierre et Jean, 1888). Balzac->Flaubert (Flaubert's
correspondence; Falconer, 'Flaubert lecteur de Balzac'). Balzac->Proust
('A propos du style de Flaubert', 1920). Gaboriau->Leblanc (Lecoq->Lupin
lineage; Messac 1929; Derouard). Flaubert->Bourget (Bourget, Essais de
psychologie contemporaine, 1883). Gaboriau->Leroux is author-level only:
the famous Rouletabille/Lecoq intertext is in Chambre jaune, which is not
the corpus's Leroux novel (La Reine du Sabbat, 1913).
Collaboration control: Maquet co-wrote La Reine Margot (1845) and sued
Dumas over credit in 1858; a known shared-hand pair, reported separately
as a positive control for textual kinship, not as influence.
